propositions: Bridge workflow must switch from continuous self-dispatch to single hourly cron entry '23 * * * *' to free the runner per operator directive

CloudWatch alarm bridge_run_failures becomes structurally unfirable at hourly cadence under old tuning (threshold=1, evaluation_periods=1) and must retune to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect sustained failures while remaining silent on single flakes
Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron and assert exactly 60-minute gaps, single schedule entry, and non-zero minute to prevent regression to multi-entry or on-:00 forms

All references to 40-minute bridge cadence across workflows, tests, docs, and comments must be updated to hourly with worst-case latency revised to 1 hour, except historical references explaining why the three-entry form existed
terraform apply is required to deploy the CloudWatch alarm retune; Terraform Drift stays red until applied, leaving bridge failures unalarmed until completion
